title: The Large TV Problem
scenario: A team needs to move a very large TV to a room on the 8th floor. The TV is inside a large box. The boxed TV will not fit through the elevator door, the garage entrance, or the room doorway. Two experienced workers suggest using a crane or carrying it up eight flights of stairs.
hidden_assumption: The TV must stay inside the box.
better_frame: How do we get the TV safely into the room?
simple_solution: Remove the TV from the box and carry the unboxed TV through the elevator and doorway.
